name: No One Will Miss Me
source:
Stuck in an existential crisis, a young woman must choose whether to live or die, and you must help her decide.

Play as a voice inside her head. Choose between Reason or Madness.

The game ends at sunset. Whoever has the strongest arguments wins.

Choose Your Perspective: Take on the role of The Voice of Reason or The Voice of Madness.

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Mechanics: Identify cognitive distortions and replace them with alternative perspectives.

Shift Interpretations, Not Reality: You cannot alter past events. Your goal is to change her relationship with those events to build, or shatter, her emotional resilience.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5314220]Steam[/url]]
